name: Hush Guard
notes: DRAFT for C13-3 (bestiary-plan.md). A quiet shield-bearer who turns to face you. Stats set in R-BAL-8 (#185/#186). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
description: A quiet shield-bearer who turns to face you.

bestiary.tip: Circle round, or STRIKE the shield.

lore.red-black: It guarded the hall so long it forgot to speak. Calm it, and it says a soft hello.
